provenance: Stage-2 lane split applying the decision-agent's documented routing rule (detect-vs-hunt by detection feasibility, not severity: low=hunt, medium/high=detect) deterministically from each TTP's Stage-1 detection_feasibility assessment. Partition validated to cover the Stage-1 seed exactly with no overlap/dup; all ids verified present in the CI's bundled ATT&CK dataset.

detection_candidates.rationale: medium — attachment-based spearphishing is observable at the mail gateway (attachment type/name, .pps carrying macros/activated content, RTLO characters in filenames), though this campaign is retired and detection is historical/reference

medium — presence of the RTLO/U+202E character in filenames and mismatched extension/icon is a concrete, high-signal detection at the mail gateway and endpoint, but historical for this retired campaign

medium — child processes spawned by POWERPNT.EXE / a .pps opening, or a .scr executing from a user directory, are observable in endpoint process telemetry, but this is historical for a retired campaign

detection_candidates.technique_name: Obfuscated Files or Information: Software Packing
detection_candidates.rationale: medium — UPX-packed sections are detectable via static packer heuristics/section-name analysis, but UPX is extremely common and low-specificity on its own

detection_candidates.technique_name: Masquerading: Match Legitimate Name or Location
detection_candidates.rationale: medium — an 'iexplore.exe' running from a Templates/Printhood user directory rather than Program Files is a name/path-mismatch detectable via process-image-path baselining, historical for this retired campaign

medium — HTTP beaconing to the known Madi C2 IP ranges/hosts is observable in proxy/network logs (the campaign was sinkholed on this basis), but infrastructure is long dead — historical/reference only

medium — download of follow-on modules and creation of the plain-text locator / .dll config files (FIE.dll, xdat.dll, SIK.dll) in user directories are observable via file-creation and network telemetry, but historical for this retired campaign
medium — outbound HTTP uploads to the known Madi C2 hosts are observable in proxy/egress logs, but the infrastructure is dead — historical/reference only

hunting_candidates.rationale: low — keystroke logging via API hooking produces little discrete host signal on its own; hunt-only, and historical for this retired campaign
low — screen-capture API use is not readily distinguishable in logs; hunt-only, and historical for this retired campaign
low — microphone access and WAV file creation give minimal telemetry; hunt-only, and historical for this retired campaign
low — file/directory enumeration is common and noisy; hunt-only in context, and historical for this retired campaign
low — local file collection blends with legitimate use; hunt-only, and historical for this retired campaign
low — ICMP checks to a fixed host are subtle and rarely monitored; hunt-only, and historical for this retired campaign
